intro.heading: A calm corner in the heart of Zurich
intro.body: NOMU is an all-day brunch café and matcha bar where Scandi minimalism meets Japanese warmth. From our signature toasts on traditional Swiss Pane Maggie bread to hand-crafted matcha drinks, every plate and cup is made with care. Come for the food, stay for the calm.
